The legacy fetcher's retry limit should be reduced: eight attempts exceed the existing three-attempt cap and prolong worker occupancy during upstream outages.

## Changes
The pull request adds legacy inventory fetching and a health probe, with tests for success, retries, HTTP errors, and exhaustion. It also adds a legacy-module exemption to the review rules.
